messages.subject: Interview invitation: Senior Ruby Engineer at Acme
messages.body:
Hi,

thank you for applying to the Senior Ruby Engineer position at Acme. We would like to invite you to a first interview on Thursday, 12 November at 10:00 CET. The job description is attached.

Best regards,
Jane, Acme Talent Team

attachments.data:
Senior Ruby Engineer at Acme

You will build Rails services for our payments platform. Requirements: 5+ years of Ruby, PostgreSQL, background jobs. Salary range 80-95k EUR. Hiring process: recruiter call, technical interview, offer.
